articles.title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs

articles.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents

articles.title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models

articles.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents

articles.title: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments

articles.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models

articles.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
articles.excerpt: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. articles.summary: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在把交互经验转化为持续提升，但外部反馈代价高，且世界模型预测随策略演化可能失准。RSI-Anything 基于 JEPA-Anything 构建领域通用框架，利用预测信号实现跨领域的自我改进。

articles.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
articles.excerpt: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. articles.title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence

articles.summary: OCR 正从纯文本转录走向通用视觉智能，要求在复杂视觉环境中识别、定位并推理文本，而现有系统往往只擅长部分任务。PolyOCR-Venus 提出统一的 OCR 基础模型，面向以文本为中心的多种视觉任务。

articles.title: MIRA: A Musical Intent Refinement Agent for Aligning Text-to-Music Generation with User Intent

articles.excerpt: 在人类到来前，塞舌尔群岛曾是动物的乐园。生活在这里的陆龟 Aldabra 象龟（Aldabrachelys gigantea）没有天敌，而且寿命极长。15 世纪之后欧洲探险家开始出现，水手、海盗紧随而至，行动缓慢的象龟成为他们唾手可得的食物。到了 19 世纪象龟数量不足一千只，濒临灭绝。最新的调查显示，经过数十年的保护，象龟数量已达到历史最高水平，数量首次超过了塞舌尔群岛的总人口。塞舌尔群岛居住着大约 12 万人。象龟数量则已超过 18 万。
